# E055 -- Channel Five

## Metadata
- **Organisation:** Channel 5 (Channel Five Broadcasting Limited)
- **Year:** 2002
- **Sector:** Media / Television Broadcasting
- **Document type:** Off-Air Design Guidelines
- **Page count:** 34
- **Format:** A4 portrait (595 x 841 pts)
- **Created with:** QuarkXPress 4.11
- **Source file:** `18995027655a531629b6998cef5b7ab0.pdf`

## Brand Strategy
- No brand strategy section. The document is a practical off-air design guidelines manual covering logotype, color, typography, formats, and image use.

## Logo
- Logotype (the "five" wordmark) is the core identity element.
- **Size rules:** Logotype must appear in proportion to headline type, determined by the baseline and cap-height of the nearest type. Scaling examples provided for single-line, two-line, and three-line headlines.
- **Color rules:** Logotype can appear in any one of 25 colors from the palette, plus black or white. Must never use more than one color.

## Typography
- Referenced in TOC (sections 1.0-5.3) but not captured in sampled pages.

## Color
- **25-color Pantone palette** split into five sets (5 colors per set, echoing the "five" brand).
- Colors specified by Pantone numbers across five spectral groups: yellows/browns, oranges/reds, blues, greens/teals, pinks/purples.
- Specific PMS values listed: 102, 161, 108, 117, 7529, 7406, 188, 7504, 138, 173, 636, 295, 551, 306, 2925, 396, 371, 297, 299, 5655, 192, 706, 204, 221, 5225.
- "Any colour can be set against any other colour. No colour can be used outside of this palette."
- Guidance to limit usage to 2-3 colors per application: "Reduction is key."

## Outliers / Noteworthy Details
- Very early 2000s document (2002), created in QuarkXPress 4.11 -- a period artifact.
- The 25-color palette organized in 5 sets of 5 is a clever structural echo of the brand name.
- Pantone-only color specification (no CMYK, RGB, or Hex values in sampled pages) reflects the print-first era.
- "Off-air" designation implies a companion "on-air" guidelines document for broadcast identity.
- Small file size (145 KB) suggests minimal imagery -- primarily text and color swatches.
- Strong legal framing: written license required for any use; trademark and copyright strictly enforced.

## Quality Score
**3 / 5** -- Well-organized and focused design guidelines with a distinctive 25-color palette system. The logotype sizing rules (proportional to headline type) show attention to typographic craft. However, the document is narrow in scope (off-air only), lacks brand strategy or verbal identity, and the Pantone-only color specs are limited. A solid practical reference for its era.
